title: PDF Export: A modernized experience
description:
We’ve refreshed the PDF export interface to align with the modern Confluence design you use every day. This update replaces legacy UI elements with a polished, contemporary look, ensuring a cohesive and visually consistent experience throughout the export process. Navigate to the Confluence page or live doc you want to export.
	Select the More actions (•••) menu at the top right of the page, then select Export to PDF.
	When the export is complete, your file will download automatically.
